import mir_eval
import numpy as np

# Adjust estimated intervals to reference boundaries
est_intervals_adj, est_labels_adj = mir_eval.util.adjust_intervals(
    est_intervals, est_labels, 
    ref_intervals.min(), ref_intervals.max(), 
    mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD, mir_eval.chord.NO_CHORD
)

# Merge into a common time grid
intervals, ref_labels_merged, est_labels_merged = mir_eval.util.merge_labeled_intervals(

)

print(f"__CHECK__ sevenths {score:.4f}")
